notes: Proton's window now opens only for the click, then closes itself
patch_notes: Stealth mode, as requested: GameMode stays minimized in the tray and never pops up when a game starts or ends. Proton's window now appears only for the moment of the automatic click — after Disconnect or Connect is clicked, GameMode closes Proton's window again by itself. Only the window closes; Proton itself and the tunnel state are untouched, and if an automatic click ever fails, the window stays open so the guided steps can be used.
